target.title: improve(gateway): restart only the changed account on channel config reload
target.body:
Related: #99311

## What Problem This Solves

On gateways running multiple accounts on one channel, any config change scoped to a
single account (adding an account, or editing `channels.{kind}.accounts.{accountId}.*`)
restarts the whole channel — every other account on it is disconnected and reconnected
even though their config did not change. On a 9-account Mattermost gateway, each
account-scoped write bounced all connected accounts for 1.0–2.6s and inflated
`config.patch` latency 3–4× during the restart window.

## Why This Change Was Made

The reload plan now distinguishes account-scoped paths from channel-global paths. When
all of a channel's changed paths are under `channels.{kind}.accounts.{accountId}[.*]`,
the executor restarts just those `(channel, accountId)` pairs through the existing
`stopChannel`/`startChannel` `accountId` parameter. Any channel-global path keeps the
wholesale restart, and a channel scheduled for wholesale restart drops its per-account
entries, so each `(channel, account)` pair restarts at most once per plan. An account
id the plugin does not list for the new config (removed, renamed, or a config key the
plugin canonicalizes differently — e.g. Matrix's `normalizeAccountId`) promotes that
channel back to a wholesale restart, which already handles stale-account eviction and
non-canonical keys. Per-account restarts mirror the wholesale path's semantics:
non-manual stops (`{ manual: false }`, so a stop timeout does not suppress recovery
scheduling), the same `abortGeneration` guard so an in-process restart is not raced,
and collect-failures-and-continue so one account's failure does not skip the rest of
the plan. `secrets.reload` (server-aux-handlers) has no per-account restart path, so
account-scoped plan entries restart their whole channel there — identical to its
behavior before this change. Malformed account paths (empty account segment) fall
back to wholesale restart. No changes to channel plugins; single-account gateways
keep equivalent behavior.

The default account (`accounts.default.*`) stays on the wholesale path: its config
subtree is the inheritance base other accounts resolve from
(`resolveChannelAccountConfig`), so changing it can affect every account. No existing
tests are modified — the pre-existing whatsapp per-account test (which uses `default`)
keeps its wholesale expectation, correctly. A plan combining a plugin reload with
purely account-scoped channel changes still defers for active work before restarting
accounts.

## User Impact

Operators running many accounts on one channel (multi-account/multi-tenant gateways)
no longer see every account disconnect when one account is added or changed. An
account-scoped reload completes in 0.2–0.7s and touches only that account.
Single-account deployments see no behavior change.

## Evidence

Side-by-side A/B on the same host (`2026.7.1-beta.1`), same gateway, sequentially
mounting 9 Mattermost accounts. Change ported to `main` for this PR: `pnpm build`
and `pnpm check` pass; the touched surface (`config-reload`, `server-reload-handlers`,
`server-aux-handlers`) is 271/271 green. Full `pnpm test` shows a handful of failures
in unrelated files (`model-compat`, `models-config.providers.moonshot`,
`media-understanding/image`) that reproduce identically on pristine `origin/main`
when tests run after `pnpm build` (they pass on a fresh checkout before building) —
a pre-existing post-build state interaction, not introduced here.

| | wholesale (before) | per-account (after) |
|---|---|---|
| restarts per account-add | whole channel | 1 account |
| other-account disconnects | all accounts, 1.0–2.6s per add (45 auto-restarts across 9 mounts) | none |
| reload completion | 0.45–1.5s | 0.18–0.7s |
| `config.patch` latency during reload | 3.3–4.9s worst | ≤2.4s worst |
| failures | none | none |

Before — one account's config write restarts everyone (8 other accounts bounce):

```
[gateway/channels] restarting mattermost channel
[mattermost] [tester5-coach] auto-restart attempt 1/10 in 5s
[mattermost] [tester25-coach] auto-restart attempt 1/10 in 5s
[mattermost] [tester19-coach] auto-restart attempt 1/10 in 5s
... (all 8 previously-connected accounts stop and reconnect)
[mattermost] connected as @tester25-coach   (~2.2s after restart began)
```

After — the same write touches only the changed account:

```
[gateway/channels] restarting mattermost account eck-coach
[reload] config hot reload applied (agents.list, channels.mattermost.accounts.eck-coach)
```

This behavior has also run in production behind our (Octogee) fork for ~10 weeks
across `2026.5.x → 2026.7.1-beta.1` with no per-account-restart incidents.

---

AI-assisted (Claude, supervised): implementation, the A/B measurement harness, and this
write-up were AI-assisted; the change has been human-reviewed and operated in production
by the author. `codex review --base origin/main` was run locally per CONTRIBUTING across
multiple rounds; findings it raised (existing plan literals missing the new field,
removed accounts restarted instead of evicted, `secrets.reload` not consuming
account-scoped plan entries, non-canonical account keys, a missing `abortGeneration`
guard, manual-stop semantics suppressing recovery, fail-fast instead of
collect-and-continue on multi-account failures, default-account inheritance requiring
wholesale restart, a missed active-work deferral when a plugin reload combines with
account-only channel changes, and account restarts racing plugin-removed channels)
were all fixed and covered by tests before opening this PR.
Happy to adjust anything — first PR here, feedback welcome.
